identificationModule.briefTitle: Tucidinostat and Nab-paclitaxel in Advanced HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of Tucidinostat and Nab-paclitaxel in Advanced HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is looking to see whether the combination of Tucidinostat and nab-paclitaxel is safe and effective in participants with advanced HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
